paper_title: Graph Neural Network Approach to Semantic Type Detection in Tables
caption: The macro f-score of GAIT_{GAT} and RECA on Semtab dataset, for High, Medium, and Low-frequency classes.
model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Macro f-score of two different methods, RECA and GAIT_{GAT}, across three frequency classes on the Semtab dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Frequency," with groups ordered from left to right as High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Macro f-score," using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 1 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1, accompanied by horizontal grid lines. The chart features grouped bars, where each frequency category contains two side-by-side bars representing the two methods. According to the legend positioned below the horizontal axis, the light peach bars represent RECA, and the dark orange bars represent GAIT_{GAT}. Each bar is visually emphasized with a slight drop shadow and is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value near the top. In the High frequency class, the RECA bar has a value of 0.837, and the GAIT_{GAT} bar is the tallest in the chart at 0.877. In the Medium frequency class, the RECA value is 0.538 and the GAIT_{GAT} value is 0.609. For the Low frequency class, the RECA bar is the shortest in the chart with a value of 0.114, while the corresponding GAIT_{GAT} bar has a value of 0.224.
